name: Tonari no Sakata
source: Tonari no Sakata is one of the four main characters and love interests in Handsome B☆Y's. He is a member of the light music club, the childhood friend of the player's heroine, and is voiced by the real-life Tonari no Sakata himself from the utaite unit Urashimasakatasen.
translation: Tonari no Sakata is one of the four main characters and love interests in Handsome B☆Y's. He is a member of the light music club, the childhood friend of the player's heroine, and is voiced by the real-life Tonari no Sakata himself from the utaite unit Urashimasakatasen.
